requirements.general: Any one of these: STPM: Minimum 2 Principal Passes (C+), credit in Mathematics in SPM, a pass in English. STAM: Minimum grade of Jayyid, credit in Mathematics in SPM, a pass in English at SPM level. A-Level: Minimum 2 Principal Passes (C) and a C in O-Level Mathematics, a pass in English at SPM level, and Band 2 MUET. UEC: Minimum 5 Bs (including Mathematics) and a pass in English. Diploma / HND: Minimum CGPA of 2.50, credit in Mathematics in SPM, a pass in English at SPM level. Foundation / Matriculation: Minimum CGPA of 2.50, credit in Mathematics in SPM, a pass in English at SPM level, and Band 2 MUET. SAM / HSC / AUSMAT:TER/UAI: Average 60% or higher in 5 subjects (including Mathematics). CPU / CIMP: Average of 60% or higher in 6 subjects. IB: 26 points or higher based on 6 subjects. Other Qualifications: As recognised by the Senate of IUKL as equivalent to STPM. Note: Candidates without a pass in Mathematics at SPM level may be admitted if their qualifications include a Mathematics subject that is equivalent to SPM level. ENGLISH LANGUAGE REQUIREMENTS: IELTS - 5.5 TOEFL (PBT) - 550 TOEFL (IBT) - 46 PTE - 51 MUET - BAND 3 Cambridge English - 160
